say:1:1035603001:1.text: A certain Syndicate camp. You can guess which one for yourself.
say:1:1035603001:1.source_cn: 某个黑金营地，具体是哪个就随便你猜了。
say:1:1035603001:1.male: A certain Syndicate camp. You can guess which one for yourself.
say:1:1035603001:1.female: A certain Syndicate camp. You can guess which one for yourself.

say:2:1035603002:1.text: All I can tell you is to keep your distance from the Adamant Syndicate and definitely don't do any work for them.
say:2:1035603002:1.source_cn: 我唯一能告诉你的就是：少和黑金打交道，更别帮他们干活儿。
say:2:1035603002:1.male: All I can tell you is to keep your distance from the Adamant Syndicate and definitely don't do any work for them.
say:2:1035603002:1.female: All I can tell you is to keep your distance from the Adamant Syndicate and definitely don't do any work for them.

say:3:1035603003:1.text: Otherwise, you might end up like me, sweating buckets in a cave or gasping for air tiredly on the road.
say:3:1035603003:1.source_cn: 不然就会像我一样，要么是在洞穴里热得冒汗，要么就是在路...
say:3:1035603003:1.male: Otherwise, you might end up like me, sweating buckets in a cave or gasping for air tiredly on the road.
say:3:1035603003:1.female: Otherwise, you might end up like me, sweating buckets in a cave or gasping for air tiredly on the road.
